note: Editor-reviewed injury-context exclusions for graded weekly rankings (Bust & Bargain, boom/bust, xFP). Keyed by player_id + franchise_id, validated against that season/week's own src_weekly before use. Never keyed by name. A player listed here keeps his raw statistical-gap evidence but is removed from any RANKED table and shown instead as a separate not-graded row.
